hypotheses.name: optimization_residual_transfer_gap
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds have S2-S1 train delta above test delta, positive train-to-test gap, and the mean gap is positive.

hypotheses.name: complementarity_conversion_failure
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds retain or improve S2 oracle/coverage while S2 vote is lower and the oracle-minus-vote gap widens.

hypotheses.name: target_concentration_association
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds have lower S2 target entropy and a descriptive association between high targeting and poorer member transfer.

hypotheses.name: update_throughput_deficit
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds have fewer S2 accepted updates than S1 and the aggregate accepted count is lower.

hypotheses.name: update_efficiency_deficit
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds have lower S2 descriptive held-out gain per accepted update together with train-to-held-out degradation.

hypotheses.name: specialization_transfer_failure
hypotheses.supported_if: At least two seeds show a stronger S2 train specialization signal that fades on test in two independent frozen measures.
